text:
```yaml
name: Auto Assign Milestone

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited, closed]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  assign-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Apply milestone policy
        uses: policybot/policybot-action@v1
        with:
          policy: .github/policies/milestoneAssignment.prClosed.yml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
